get.description: Returns the latest **confirmed** decision for the event and company. Confirmed statuses: selected, confirmed, accepted, done. Cancelled plans are excluded. Ordering: created_at DESC, id DESC. Draft / incomplete plans are not returned — clients must not treat a missing decision as an actionable plan. Use 404 when no confirmed decision exists.

post.description: Отправка сообщения в обсуждение. При ASSISTANT_AGENT_LOOP=false — legacy-путь. При ASSISTANT_AGENT_LOOP=true и ASSISTANT_PROVIDER=hackathon — многошаговый read-only цикл (AgentLoopRunner). Неподдерживаемое сочетание провайдера и режима → ASSISTANT_AGENT_LOOP_UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER (без fallback). Незавершённый цикл не возвращает successful final: ASSISTANT_LOOP_TIMEOUT (504), ASSISTANT_LOOP_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (429), ASSISTANT_LOOP_NO_PROGRESS / ASSISTANT_LOOP_INVALID_ACTION / ASSISTANT_LOOP_INCOMPLETE (409), плюс ACL/provider ошибки. Повтор того же client_message_id + того же текста после успеха — 200 reused без HTTP; после остановки — тот же ASSISTANT_LOOP_* (details.reused, not_ai_final), не successful final. Тот же id + другой текст — ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT. Подробности: docs/ASSISTANT_AGENT_API_INTEGRATION.md, docs/ASSISTANT_AGENT_REPLAY_FIX.md.

409.description: Loop incomplete / in progress / ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT (same id, different text)

post.description: Явный пользовательский запуск сравнения сценариев (finance и/или supply-chain) без LLM и без write-tools agent loop. Тот же client_request_id + те же параметры → reused; тот же id + другие параметры → 409 USER_COMPARE_REQUEST_CONFLICT. Decision не создаётся. См. docs/USER_TRIGGERED_FINANCE_SCENARIOS.md.

409.description: USER_COMPARE_REQUEST_CONFLICT or CALCULATION_UNAVAILABLE path surfaced in result payload

feed_sort_rule.title: Feed Sort Rule
feed_sort_rule.default: Groups: company_calculated, then event_severity_signal, then case_profile_match; within impact groups impact_score DESC; within case_profile_match occurred_at DESC; tie-break event_id ASC. Bases are not compared by one number. Cursor: '{group}:{sort_key}:{event_id}'.

impact_score_available.description: Explicit availability of impact_score. False ⇒ no assessment (impact_score is null); do not display as zero.
